Can you provide the coördinates you entered in the config flow?

I tried moving the pin a bit, but did not help.

For example:
Lat: 51,386181609752356
Long: 5,44379884377122

I checked it a bit, could it be that the API used to convert the coordinates is changed?

Thanks for checking it.
Gr Stan

Thank you, the API to transform coordinates has changed indeed. 
Please follow PR [#139063](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/139063)

review_comments: Here we mock the return value with a tuple but in fact the return value is a set.

Python sets are unordered. That looks like a bug in the library since we need to know what is the latitude and what is the longitude.

https://github.com/fwestenberg/stookwijzer/blob/89dcfb89f6f61536687c5963fff19e99bc3a8337/stookwijzer/stookwijzerapi.py#L97

Actually after conversion it is X and Y, rather than latitude and longitude. But this needs another migration in the init.py. I don't think this is worth the effort..
Regarding the unordered set, I will create another PR for that.
